_schema.apex_name: API name of the Apex class or trigger
_schema.cmt_record_qualified_name: CmtType.DeveloperName — used to locate the CMT record in the package or query the org
_schema.cmt_object_api_name: (optional) override the derived object API name (e.g. MyType__mdt)
_schema.cmt_developer_name: (optional) override the derived DeveloperName for the org query
_schema.switch_field: (optional) checkbox field API name on the CMT object; defaults to Turn_on__c
_schema.tests_when_enabled: test class name(s) to run when the switch field is true — string or array
_schema.tests_when_disabled: test class name(s) to run when the switch field is false — string or array
